generic_sampling_rules.int_pk: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table; never NULL; never overwritten by shaping passes.
generic_sampling_rules.int_fk: Sample from the parent table's generated primary-key pool; allow NULL only if the column is nullable; never overwritten with non-key placeholders.
generic_sampling_rules.int_quantity: Integer in [1, 200]; occasionally 0 or negative only if a range rule allows it.
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: Pick from a small pool of realistic names; allow near-duplicates (case/whitespace variants) and occasional NULL if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: Pick uniformly from the enum values listed in per_column_exceptions.
generic_sampling_rules.text_time: Format 'HH:MM' with HH in 00-23 and MM in 00-59.
generic_sampling_rules.text_free: Short realistic phrase; allow near-duplicates and occasional NULL if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_numeric: For each listed literal L, generate L-0.001, L, L+0.001 (or integer step 1 for INT).
generic_sampling_rules.tie_order: Ensure at least two rows share the tie value at the listed rank.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For nullable columns, ~10% NULL rows per instance, at least one NULL row; NOT NULL columns never get NULL; planted NULLs are never replaced to satisfy a rule.

per_column_exceptions.targets: station.Station_ID, station.Name, station.Location, station.Main_Services, station.Number_of_Platforms, train_station.Station_ID
per_column_exceptions.rule: Ensure group sizes 1, 2 and >=3 occur when grouping by these columns. Shape by repeating actual values from the column's own domain (integer key values for INT columns, pool values for text columns); never inject string placeholders into INT columns and never overwrite PK/FK values with values outside the parent key pool.
Include parent rows with no child rows and child rows whose FK matches a parent; no NULL FKs (NOT NULL columns).
Ensure COUNT(*) and COUNT(col) values 1, 2, 3 occur across groups; shape by repeating actual key/pool values, not synthetic placeholders.

per_column_exceptions.targets: train_station.Station_ID, station.Name, station.Location, station.Annual_interchanges, station.Main_Services, train.Time
per_column_exceptions.rule: Create ties at rank 1 for DESC/ASC orderings on the listed aggregates/columns; for train.Time ensure at least two rows share the earliest time (LIMIT 100 tie is relaxed to match the 11-row table size).
20-50% duplicate share on DISTINCT columns; for train_station.Train_ID duplicate only across rows with distinct Station_ID so the composite PK stays unique.

Include values 24.999, 25, 25.001 for Annual_entry_exit; 8.999, 9, 9.001, 24.999, 25, 25.001 for Total_Passengers. Negative literals (-21.001, -21, -20.999) are dropped because Total_Passengers >= 0 and equals a sum of non-negatives; the formula rule takes precedence over boundary planting.
Column is NOT NULL; no NULL rows generated.

supporting_evidence.Total_Passengers formula: station rows 1-8 show Total_Passengers = Annual_entry_exit + Annual_interchanges within rounding.
supporting_evidence.Total_Passengers NULL handling: Total_Passengers is nullable; when either operand is NULL the formula is not applied (SQL three-valued logic) and the row keeps its NULL.

uncertainty: Location values in sample include 'Glasgow' not matching station names; treated as independent free text with no correlation to Name. Main_Services free text. Train.Name duplicates allowed. The train.Time LIMIT 100 tie is relaxed to two rows because the table has only 11 rows.
